passwordReset.subject: Reset your Izbik password
passwordReset.title: Reset your password
passwordReset.intro: Someone asked to reset the password of your Izbik account. Choose a new one with the link below.
passwordReset.footnote: The link works once, for {minutes} minutes. If you did not ask for it, ignore this mail; your password stays as it is.

emailVerification.subject: Confirm your email for Izbik
emailVerification.title: Confirm your email
emailVerification.intro: Please confirm that this is the address of your Izbik account with the link below.
emailVerification.footnote: The link works once, for {hours} hours. If you did not create an Izbik account, ignore this mail.
